description: Deterministically optimize top-level rackmount equipment U positions and rear PDU face assignments to eliminate chassis or plug-clearance collisions, lower the vertical Center of Gravity below 0.50, preserve mid-height front-to-rear cable portals, and minimize 3D cable arc lengths. Evaluates candidate zoned and locally refined layouts against the full 3D geometry, 5-stage validation, and Catmull-Rom routing engines while keeping carrier sub-modules inside their parent bays, keeping existing cables and external endpoints intact, and locking any devices or parent carriers named in 'pin_instance_ids'. Only commits a strictly improving, non-regressing layout to rack.yaml and pushes an undo snapshot when at least one device moves, making repeated calls safely idempotent. Use when a rack has collisions, top-heavy warnings, or unclustered patch cabling; use modify_equipment instead to move a single device to an explicit U slot.

pin_instance_ids.description: Optional list of mounted device or child sub-module instance_id values whose current U position and rack face must remain locked during optimization.
